page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7a.2xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs running at a base frequency of 2.55 GHz. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations reveal strong single-core CPU performance, placing it in the top 25% of tested instances. However, multi-core performance and memory bandwidth for large, uncached blocks fall into the average and weak categories respectively, with uncached read speeds at 39.27 GB/sec and write speeds at 18.99 GB/sec. Cryptographic operations and integer calculations are supported by hardware-level instructions such as AES, VAES, and SHA_NI.

This instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for general-purpose workloads that require dedicated CPU resources without massive memory or local storage overhead. It is well-suited for applications such as static web serving, database operations, and lightweight software compilation. It can also handle small-scale language model inference, though performance degrades significantly on larger models.
